answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1263 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the nebula. The fable index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the pulse queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. A 141 account operation therefore ties up 23 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
